title: Mogitate SegaSaturn Vol. 5
native_title: モギタテセガサターン Ｖｏｌ．５ １９９８．１１
overview: The fifth issue of Mogitate Sega Saturn, the members-only information disc sent to Sega Partners, Sega's Saturn fan club. This issue carries Dreamcast information as a special feature, including the unveiling of Sonic Adventure at the Tokyo International Forum.
